liam (People Ops): Quick heads-up: end-of-cycle manager checklist posted. Core items: verify role ladders, flag PIPs, confirm cross-functional contributors, upload evidence.
rachel (People Ops): Please note: any active PIP must be marked in the "performance_flags" column so compensation is paused until review completes.
noor (Eng Manager): For cross-functional contributors (e.g., design/ops), do we include their leads in calibration packets?
liam (People Ops): Yes include a one-line contributor note + lead's feedback link. We won't require the other lead to attend calibration, but add them as reviewers if they want to weigh in.
faye (Customer Success): How should we handle customer-impact metrics that are behind dashboards?
rachel (People Ops): Paste a short snapshot in the evidence doc and add the dashboard link. Ensure people-ops and the manager have view access.
audit-bot: Reminder: audit export will capture files referenced in packets; missing links may slow approvals.
noor (Eng Manager): If someone is on LOA and partially contributing, do we rate on current contribution or full-year expectations?
liam (People Ops): Rate based on contribution period. In the packet, note LOA dates and the adjusted expectations. We'll annotate the record for calibration.
faye (Customer Success): Is there an appeals process for ICs after manager conversations?
rachel (People Ops): Appeals run through a two-stage process: manager -> calibration chair -> people-ops investigation. Managers should document rationales in the manager note; appeals require new evidence.
noor (Eng Manager): Any quick template for documenting cross-team work?
liam (People Ops): Use 3 bullets: scope, impact (metric or outcome), ask (level/promo/recognition). Short and specific.
audit-bot: Action: final manager uploads and packet links snapshot at 23:59 PT on 2024-07-12. After snapshot only people-ops can modify.
rachel (People Ops): We'll run a validation sweep 24h before snapshot and DM any missing items. DM us if you need a proxy or an alt reviewer assigned.
noor (Eng Manager): Great, thanks. I'll consolidate evidence tonight and flag two cross-functional contributors.
liam (People Ops): Thanks everyone — final checklist and a one-page flowchart will be in the drive (people-ops/review-flow.pdf).
